caption: Gate level, Tiny Aya Earth, test activations (A100), EORS-S condition direction (layer 13, fitted on the calibration fit fold). For budgets ε = .02 to .30, thresholds come from the conformal fold, pooled over languages or per language; points show the realised mean and worst-language false-firing on benign test prompts (a) and mean detection of harmful test prompts in the low-resource (bn, sw, jv; solid) and high-resource (en, zh, it, vi; dashed) tiers (b). Exploratory.
alt_text: Two line charts. Left: the per-language curve lies below the pooled one for worst-language false-firing. Right: at the same mean false-firing, per-language thresholds detect fewer low-resource and more high-resource harmful prompts than the pooled threshold.
